description: An insider's white Burgundy from Hubert Lamy's densely-planted Saint-Aubin holdings. Taut and struck-match in its youth, it shows pear, citrus zest and dried white flowers over a mineral core of wet stone and toasted hazelnut. Medium- to full-bodied and satiny, it rides a racy line of acidity to a long, saline finish.
sommelierNotes: Serve at around 12°C with roast poultry, richer white fish, or a wedge of aged Comté.
aroma: Pear, citrus zest, dried white flowers, hazelnut and wet stone
palate: Satiny and layered, orange rind and bitter lemon over a racy spine of acidity
